The federal court will most likely remand the entire case (A). Under 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a), only a defendant may remove, and this plaintiff removed her own suit, so the removal is defective and the timely motion to remand must be granted under § 1447(c). My earlier answer (D) was wrong, and the team note is also wrong: a plaintiff cannot remove, whatever the timing or the presence of federal claims.

CONFIDENCE: 85
